coverage.title: Research question
coverage.finding: Can the proposed county budget restore recurring balance while preserving essential service capacity? This is a conditional fiscal analysis, not an audit.

coverage.title: Status
coverage.finding: The Nov. 19 directory had no linked adopted budget. The October proposal is not an enacted appropriation. [S3]

coverage.title: Method
coverage.finding: Compare stages and fund-level categories; preserve original rounding, separate one-time resources, and distinguish predictions from outcomes.

coverage.title: All-funds baseline
coverage.finding: 2026 budget $255.83M, 2027 initial proposal $217.28M, before targeted General Fund reductions. [S1 p2]

coverage.title: Adjusted stage
coverage.finding: Subtracting the $9.81M target gives $207.47M, a derived 18.9% decline from the 2026 budget, not an official final all-funds total. [S1 pp2,7]

coverage.title: General Fund flows
coverage.finding: Reported proposed sources $122.67M and after-target spending $121.40M; county reports $1.26M surplus. The $0.01M displayed arithmetic discrepancy is rounding, not evidence of wrongdoing. [S1 p8]

coverage.title: Revenue structure
coverage.finding: Property tax $59.23M; sales/use/ownership $37.37M; fees $12.57M; grants $5.88M; other revenue/transfers $7.52M. New debt proceeds zero in proposed 2027. [S1 p4]

coverage.title: Revenue risk
coverage.finding: Grant decline and absent new debt proceeds explain much of the comparative sources decline; neither is necessarily a recurring tax-base loss. [S1 p4]

coverage.title: Capital exposure
coverage.finding: Capital outlays across governmental funds increased from $10.9M in 2021 to $118.8M in 2024; compare completed projects and funded obligations before calling planned reductions service cuts. [S2 PDF p2]

coverage.title: Marijuana receipts
coverage.finding: County reports $14.3M in 2021 and $5.4M in 2025, across restricted and other streams; 2025 unaudited. [S2 PDF p3]

coverage.title: Operating cost drivers
coverage.finding: Insurance, detention medical and gross health claims rose between 2023 and 2025; test price, utilization, claims and reimbursements separately. [S2 PDF pp4,6]

coverage.title: Debt service
coverage.finding: Governmental-fund debt service was $9M in 2021 and $19.8M in 2024. The 2027 General Fund starting proposal includes $21.35M debt service. Verify series, due dates, coverage and fund. [S2 PDF p5; S1 p5]

coverage.title: One-time financing
coverage.finding: The $0.90M projected opening 2027 General Fund balance assumes $7M asset sale and $15M COP financing in 2026. Neither transaction's closing is verified here. [S1 p9]

coverage.title: Asset disposition
coverage.finding: Request appraisals, sale resolutions, transaction costs, net proceeds, restrictions and collateral terms before assessing value or liquidity.

coverage.title: Financing failure sensitivity
coverage.finding: If net usable receipts assumed in the opening balance do not arrive, model opening balance deterioration separately from the annual operating result; debt-service consequences must be separately recalculated.

coverage.title: Fund restrictions
coverage.finding: Do not offset a deficit in one fund using another fund's positive balance without documented legal authority and cash availability.

coverage.title: Road and Bridge
coverage.finding: October projection: opening -$5.48M, closing -$5.10M. Investigate interfund advances, receivables, cash, legal restrictions and road condition. [S1 p9]

coverage.title: Human Services
coverage.finding: October projection: closing -$0.50M. County says no targeted personnel cuts in this fund; this does not eliminate the negative projection or establish unchanged access. [S1 p9; S5]

coverage.title: E911
coverage.finding: Projected ending budgetary balance $4.91M; determine statutory restrictions before any cross-fund analysis. [S1 p9]

coverage.title: Reduction method
coverage.finding: Targets derive from eligible personnel budgets, not 15% of all spending; independent offices choose how to meet targets. [S2 PDF p11; S5]

coverage.title: Sheriff
coverage.finding: October reduction target $4.89M, preliminary $46.33M, post-target $41.44M. No direct translation into layoff counts. [S1 p6]

coverage.title: Current staffing signal
coverage.finding: KRDO Nov. 18 reports a sheriff staff warning about likely layoffs; number and scope had not been decided. Obtain dated final office plan. [S6]

coverage.title: Other departments
coverage.finding: DA $0.84M; facilities $0.68M; clerk $0.60M; planning $0.49M; IT $0.48M targets. Track workload rather than assuming across-the-board service loss. [S1 p6]

coverage.title: Emergency services
coverage.finding: Monitor dispatch queue, response-time percentiles, staffing coverage and mutual aid. Any threshold requires legal and operational review.

coverage.title: Detention
coverage.finding: Track occupancy, mandatory care, vacancies, overtime, staff injury and contract costs; a cut can shift spending instead of reducing it.

coverage.title: Courts and prosecution
coverage.finding: Track case processing, statutory deadlines, vacancy rates and diversion capacity; separate county, district and municipal authority.

coverage.title: Children and families
coverage.finding: Track actual food, housing, protection and childcare caseloads and wait times; impacts are hypotheses until service data exist.

coverage.title: Nonprofits and CSAC
coverage.finding: Verify executed city/county agreements, appropriations, receivables, payments and provider-level continuity before quantifying cost shifts. Related report: report-csac-2027.html.

coverage.title: City crossover
coverage.finding: City and county budgets are separate. City proposals and county withdrawals may affect shared services; never sum balances or assume a transfer. [S7]

coverage.title: Wastewater and utilities
coverage.finding: City sewer and regulated electric rates have distinct financing and authority; analyze household burden and emergency demand, not presumed county General Fund liabilities.

coverage.title: Reserves
coverage.finding: County outlook sets a 10% interim floor and 16.67% stabilization target, distinct from TABOR. Verify the policy denominator and qualified reserves before claiming compliance. [S2 PDF p10]

coverage.title: Liquidity
coverage.finding: Require a rolling 13-week cash forecast, trustee-payment calendar, aged payables/receivables and interfund balance reconciliation.

coverage.title: Stress-test methodology
coverage.finding: Annual result in millions = 1.26 − 122.67 × revenue miss fraction − 9.81 × unrealized savings fraction − unexpected cost. Ending balance = 0.90 + annual result − opening financing shortfall. Conditional static model, no probabilities.

coverage.title: Sensitivity
coverage.finding: Baseline +$1.26M; 1% revenue miss +$0.0333M; 2% miss −$1.1934M; 80% savings delivery −$0.702M; combined 2% miss, 80% savings and $2M cost −$5.1554M. Model does not predict outcomes.

coverage.title: Recovery options
coverage.finding: Compare procurement, shared services, attrition, preventative maintenance, grant recovery and debt restructuring by net recurring cost and service performance. No savings assumed without evidence.

coverage.title: Governance
coverage.finding: County reports finance leadership reassignment and planned monthly reporting, financial controls and debt-payment processes. Verify dated outputs and independent review. [S2 PDF pp9,12–14; S5]

coverage.title: Public participation
coverage.finding: Official calendar lists Dec. 4 final Workday adjustment and Dec. 10 adoption hearing. Recheck notice and location before attending. [S4]

coverage.title: Records and audit
coverage.finding: Request final budget, amendments, audits, monthly ledgers, debt agreements, appraisals, staffing plans, grant obligations and service data; seek redacted aggregate information.

coverage.title: TTL and corrections
coverage.finding: Recheck active decisions daily, monthly finance on issuance, structural risks quarterly; stale evidence remains visible with its date. Append corrections with source, reason and reviewer.

coverage.title: Conclusion and limits
coverage.finding: The proposal offers a narrow conditional surplus, not proof of structural recovery. Full 18.93 MB budget book retrieval failed; no detailed audit, final layoffs, cash validation or financing close verified. Human editorial approval and deployment verification remain required. [S1–S6]

model.note: Conditional model; no probability or legal conclusion.
